parks.name: Everglades National Park
parks.blurb: River of grass and mangroves; alligators, manatees, wading birds and crocodiles.

parks.name: Dry Tortugas National Park
parks.blurb: Coral islands and old fort; sea turtles, frigatebirds, sooty terns and fish.

parks.name: Merritt Island National Wildlife Refuge
parks.blurb: Lagoons and marsh beside Kennedy Space Center; manatees, alligators and spoonbills.

parks.name: J.N. Ding Darling National Wildlife Refuge
parks.blurb: Mangroves on Sanibel Island; roseate spoonbills, manatees, ibis and dolphins.

parks.name: Myakka River State Park
parks.blurb: Prairie and river; alligators, wading birds, deer and wild boar.

parks.name: Paynes Prairie Preserve State Park
parks.blurb: Prairie basin near Gainesville; wild horses, bison, alligators and sandhill cranes.

parks.name: Silver Springs State Park
parks.blurb: Crystal clear springs; turtles, manatees, monkeys and alligators.

parks.name: Homosassa Springs Wildlife State Park
parks.blurb: Spring-fed river; manatees, alligators, river otters and wading birds.

parks.name: Big Cypress National Preserve
parks.blurb: Cypress swamp; alligators, Florida panthers, bobcats and wading birds.

parks.name: Corkscrew Swamp Sanctuary
parks.blurb: Old-growth cypress boardwalk; wood storks, alligators, otters and owls.

parks.name: St. Marks National Wildlife Refuge
parks.blurb: Salt marsh and pine woods; alligators, migrating hawks, ducks and manatees.

parks.name: Wekiwa Springs State Park
parks.blurb: Spring run and forest near Orlando; manatees, turtles, black bears and deer.
